notes.title: AI update!
notes.content:
Lots of AI fixes and tweaking.
Protectors (bugs and bulldogs) now have weaker weapons (but not "weak").
Player's weapon unlocks have more sense now (theoretically the more you play, the better the weapon).
All bots now have medium quality weapons.
Protectors spawn was fixed (sometimes they were too slow to enable shields).
And some more fixes.
Let me know in the forums if something is wrong.

So, what's next?
New game mode ;)

Droo.

notes.title: Base VS Base!
notes.content:
New game mode has arrived!
Go blow up enemy base and don't forget to protect yours at the same time.
There are also a lot of tweaks to bugs and AI, so please leave your feedback in the forums.
Also shotguns are now more powered, maybe too much. Will see till the next big update.

Next step - Winter Map.

See you on the battlefield.
- Droo
